Hole-by-depth heatmap

Source: R/plot_depth.R
plot_depth_heatmap.Rd

Holes across, depth down, tile colour = value of one analyte. Holes are ordered by x (or by order) so lateral trends read left to right.

Usage

plot_depth_heatmap(
  ds,
  method,
  analyte,
  breaks = NULL,
  order = "x",
  palette = "scholar"
)

Arguments

ds

A gc_data object.

method, analyte

Which analyte.

breaks

Depth-bin width (or vector of breaks) passed to gc_interval_stats(); NULL uses each sample's own interval.

order

Hole order: "x", "y", or a character vector.

palette

A sequential palette name for gc_pal() (default "scholar").

Value

A ggplot.

Examples

plot_depth_heatmap(gc_example, "SRA", "TOC")
